description: This file contains functions for interacting with a WordPress GraphQL API, including fetching posts, post previews, and related data.

methods.name: fetchAPI
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the API URL with a GraphQL query and variables, handling errors and returning data.

methods.name: getPreviewPost
methods.description: Fetches a preview post by ID or slug, returning post details.

methods.name: getAllPostsWithSlug
methods.description: Retrieves all post slugs, limited to 10,000 posts.

methods.name: getAllPostsForHome
methods.description: Fetches recent posts for homepage display, including metadata and author info.

methods.name: getPostAndMorePosts
methods.description: Fetches a specific post by slug or ID, along with additional recent posts, handling drafts and revisions.
